name: @oge-ui/server
description: Server side of the OGE UI data grid: checks grid requests against a field allowlist and answers them with parameterized SQL for PostgreSQL, MySQL / MariaDB, SQLite and SQL Server — filtering by the published filter contract, search, sorting, paging, grouping, summaries and header-filter values. Driver-agnostic; works with pg, mysql2, node:sqlite, better-sqlite3 and mssql.
author: kaya2m
